text:
marta: Heads-up — embedding/rerank endpoint in eu-west started returning 429s ~09:12 UTC. Queue depth jumped and admission controller started throttling. Anyone on call?

jay: I see the alerts. admission-controller logs show rerank lane hit max_inflight and we started shedding. Looks like a bursty internal eval job overlapped with customer traffic.

sre-bot: Incident detected: embed-rerank-eu-west-throttle triggered at 2026-11-02T09:12:34Z (rule: lane_inflight_threshold)

dennis: We had split lanes, but rerank is still on the small shared pool due to historical capacity limits. Embeddings and rerank share a qps/fairshare bucket. When rerank bursted it ate eviction tokens.

claire: How bad is customer impact? Any high-severity pages?

marta: A handful of 429s surfaced in prod (low %), plus a notable increase in tail latency for some P95 requests. No P0s so far.

jay: Quick mitigation: I toggled the rerank QoS to strict admission for small queries only, and bumped embed backoff. That helped drop error rate but increased embed latency.

marta: We need a long-term plan: propose carving a small dedicated rerank lane that never competes with embeddings. Rerank is latency-sensitive and cheaper per-token compared to emb jobs.

dennis: Agreed. Draft config proposal below (for discussion):

```yaml
admission:
  rerank_dedicated_lane:
    capacity_gpus: 4
    max_concurrency: 120
    qps_limit: 180
    eviction_policy: protect
  embed_shared_lane:
    capacity_gpus: auto_burst
    max_concurrency: 800
    qps_limit: 900
    eviction_policy: best_effort
routing:
  prioritize: rerank_dedicated_lane
  fallback: embed_shared_lane
```

jon: (ops-bot) estimated cost: 4x A100 ded. ~= $12k/month in eu-west (inc infra). Can tighten concurrency to lower cost.

claire: Cost seems reasonable if it avoids customer-facing 429s. Need a perf test plan and a rollback path.

marta: Action items: 1) I'll open infra PR to provision 4 GPUs in eu-west and add the new lane config. 2) @jay please add an e2e perf test that floods rerank patterns and measures P95 and 429 rate. 3) @dennis write rollout playbook (canary % and autoscale knobs).

jay: Will do the perf harness. Suggest starting with a canary at 10% traffic routed to new lane, ramp to 50% if stable.

dennis: I'll draft the playbook and include a graceful admission toggle and metric alerts: rerank_429_rate, rerank_p95_tokens, lane_utilization.

marta: Cool. Let's try to get infra PR + perf test by EOD tomorrow. If anyone wants to split the work ping me. :thumbsup:

claire: +1. Also let's add a cheap billing guard to prevent runaway cost during initial weeks.

ops-bot: Note: created ticket INF-2143 to provision dedicated rerank lane and TRAFFIC-512 for the perf test.

marta: Thanks all — will post updates in this thread when PR lands.
